options.content: Select a room and user from the tables. Topology and tables query **current server state** and do not replay the time picker. Navigation preserves the interval for retained logs. A missing selection or expired room can return 404. Query errors and unavailable observations are not healthy results.

panels.title: Active Rooms
panels.description: Current rooms and transport counts. Click a room to inspect current topology. These rows are independent of the selected historical interval.

panels.title: Current Room Topology: ${room_uuid}
panels.description: Current room diagnostics projected into users, sources and subscription paths. The time picker does not replay topology. Missing rooms return HTTP 404. Missing source or user observations remain visible as placeholders.

panels.title: Room Users
panels.description: Current users in the room. IncomingBps measures sending only. Select a user for current topology or a retained-log investigation with the same time range.

panels.title: Current User Media Path: ${user_id}
panels.description: Current room diagnostics projected into users, sources and subscription paths. Shows the selected user and their producers and receivers through media workers. An absent user has no graph. The time picker does not replay topology. Missing rooms return HTTP 404. Missing source or user observations remain visible as placeholders.

panels.title: Server-wide Source Selection Activity
panels.description: Server-wide counter rates in the selected interval. This metric has no room or user labels, so selecting a room does not scope this chart. Activity does not establish unstable connectivity.
